cards.art: Yellow rabbit curator surveying paper avalanche with clipboard
cards.lore: The jokes are just a shield to let the truth slip in behind them.
cards.name: Uncle FrizzleBob, The Curator
cards.power: Documents domestic decay with awe, dread, and a clipboard held too close to the chest.

cards.art: Raccoon queen enthroned in glorious mess, crown askew
cards.lore: Chaos isn't an accident; it's a fractal, self-organizing lifestyle choice.
cards.name: The Marvelous Miss Messy
cards.power: Rejects the concept of putting things back so completely that the room becomes the work.

cards.art: Pelican curator on pedestal addressing garbage heap
cards.lore: Put a forensic marker on a dirty plate, and it stops being gross and starts being avant-garde.
cards.name: The Museum of Modern Mess (MoMM)
cards.power: Reframes a flatmate's biohazardous neglect into a self-important, high-art retrospective.

cards.art: Sloth cocooned in caution tape amid mushrooms and textiles
cards.lore: The art doesn't just sit there—it touches you back.
cards.name: Mixed Medium Decomposition
cards.power: Combines textiles, ceramics, snack packaging, and slow, patient rotting into a living installation.

cards.art: Beaver buried beneath archaeological layers of books and papers
cards.lore: A FLAT SURFACE IS JUST A CHALLENGE WAITING TO BE BURIED UNDER FOUR IDENTIFIED STRATA.
cards.name: The Desk (A Myth)
cards.power: RECLASSIFIES ALL DESIGNATED WORKSTATIONS INTO PERMANENT, LOAD-BEARING STORAGE.

cards.art: Porcupine bristling with forks on white background
cards.lore: VIEWER DISCRETION IS MANDATORY WHEN THE BLANKETS HAVE SHARP EDGES.
cards.name: The Bed Fork
cards.power: INTRODUCES EXPOSED CUTLERY TO THEORETICAL SLEEPING SPACES.

cards.art: Camel balancing impossible tower of mugs on back
cards.lore: REMOVE THE BOTTOM CUP, AND THE ENTIRE ECOSYSTEM COLLAPSES.
cards.name: Load-Bearing Beverage
cards.power: STACKS EMPTY CUPS UNTIL THEY BECOME STRUCTURALLY INTEGRAL TO THE ROOM'S ARCHITECTURE.

cards.art: Octopus submerged in clothing strata with geological depth chart
cards.lore: YOU CAN CARBON-DATE THE MOOD BY THE DEPTH OF THE SWEATPANTS.
cards.name: The Textile Stratum
cards.power: LAYERS UNWASHED CLOTHING INTO HISTORICAL SEDIMENT DATING BACK AN ESTIMATED SIX WEEKS.

cards.art: Flamingo standing in sink drain flirting with toothbrush
cards.lore: Oral care hits different when it shares real estate with a surface hygiene of 0/10.
cards.name: The Drain Toothbrush
cards.power: Habitats exclusively inside the sink basin, flirting dangerously with the plumbing.

cards.art: Crowned owl on toilet lid with whiteboard of wrong equations
cards.lore: No one knows what was being calculated, but the math is definitely wrong.
cards.name: Confused Monarch Whiteboard
cards.power: Presides over the toilet with unresolved, mathematical authority.

cards.art: Skunk beside murky mystery glass container with emanating fumes
cards.lore: You don't want to know what it held, but your survival instincts demand it.
cards.name: The Classified Vessel
cards.power: Holds ambiguous liquids of unknown age, commanding a wide berth.

cards.art: Vulture draped in damp towel under sink pipes
cards.lore: It's not a discarded towel; it's an anti-fashion statement.
cards.name: Balenciaga Under-Sink Pile
cards.power: Stages high-fashion despair in the dampest, least appropriate corner of the house.

cards.art: Hermit crab inhabiting entire sofa in laundry shell
cards.lore: The laundry river flows outward at a vector of three garments per day.
cards.name: The Sofa Wardrobe
cards.power: Reclassifies communal seating into a personal closet by popular vote of one.

cards.art: Mountain goat balanced atop towering stack of dirty plates
cards.lore: It isn't a kitchen hazard, it's a daring feat of vertical engineering.
cards.name: The Dish Summit
cards.power: Stacks up to five days of plates on a single, groaning bamboo tray.

cards.art: Armadillo curled beside fossilized tomato in excavation site
cards.lore: If you leave it long enough, you don't have to clean it—you have to excavate it.
cards.name: The Fossilized Tomato
cards.power: Petrifies organic matter until it becomes part of the permanent geological record.

cards.art: Mourning dove lying on trampled paper hearts in dusty floor
cards.lore: Love dies here, and it gets stepped on in dirty socks.
cards.name: Trampled Valentines
cards.power: Crushes handmade paper affections into the dusty floorboards.

cards.art: Laughing hyena holding phone, defending mess with hearts
cards.lore: The way she layers laundry like sediment?? Tate Modern is shaking.
cards.name: The Stan (@avantgarbage)
cards.power: Defends every biohazard as a misunderstood, avant-garde masterpiece.

cards.art: Stern turtle with glasses pointing accusatorially at viewer
cards.lore: In MY day a made bed built character. This is how you get silverfish.
cards.name: The Boomer (@Reinhard_1957)
cards.power: Summons the judgment of the 1950s to diagnose your lack of character.

cards.art: Hound dog with magnifying glass zooming into dark corner
cards.lore: Is that Coca-Cola or evidence. asking for the lab.
cards.name: The Investigator (@notaCSIagent)
cards.power: Zooms in on the darkest corners of the photo to demand forensic answers.

cards.art: Glowing-green opossum playing dead in slime puddle
cards.lore: combining dirty dishes + a clothing avalanche is diabolical work actually.
cards.name: The Repulsed (@gagreflex)
cards.power: Smells the picture through the screen and immediately requires medical attention.

cards.art: Pufferfish exploding with lightning bolts, stress hormones firing
cards.lore: The piles of unfinished tasks are actively yelling at your nervous system.
cards.name: Cortisol Stress Spike
cards.power: Keeps stress hormones permanently switched on in cluttered family homes (Saxbe & Repetti, 2010).

cards.art: Chameleon tangled in thought-spiral vortex
cards.lore: Your brain is actively competing with the trash for your attention.
cards.name: The Attention Pull
cards.power: Visually pulls at your focus until you can't finish a single thought (McMains & Kastner, 2011).

cards.art: Snake made of laundry eating itself in infinite loop
cards.lore: The piles and the putting-off feed each other in an infinite cycle.
cards.name: Procrastination Feedback Loop
cards.power: Overwhelms the victim until putting things off becomes the only viable strategy (Ferrari & Roster, 2015).

cards.art: Badger hoarding cookies compulsively in chaotic kitchen
cards.lore: A chaotic environment translates directly into chaotic consumption.
cards.name: Chaotic Kitchen Snacker
cards.power: Forces you to eat twice as many cookies just to cope with the visual noise (Vartanian et al., 2017).

cards.art: Bee on perfect honeycomb in golden ordered light
cards.lore: An orderly room literally makes you a slightly better person.
cards.name: Kinder Choices
cards.power: Nudges the brain toward healthier food and more generous behavior (Vohs et al., 2013).

cards.art: Koala sleeping peacefully in fresh white bed with eucalyptus
cards.lore: Making the bed is the first defense against existential dread.
cards.name: Fresh Sheet Headspace
cards.power: Links steady personal hygiene routines with higher self-esteem and better sleep (Sleep Foundation).

cards.art: Stag standing in cleared patch of forest floor
cards.lore: Plainly: this isn't nagging. It's the baseline of living with yourself.
cards.name: Quiet Self-Respect
cards.power: Carves out a physical zone where a human being can actually breathe.

cards.art: Cicada emitting calming ripple waves over flat chaos below
cards.lore: Sometimes you just need to opt-in to the quiet.
cards.name: Room Tone Ambient
cards.power: Generates a procedural, calming drone to mask the screeching chaos of a shared flat.

cards.art: Shield bug surrounded by toxic green cloud dominating room
cards.lore: Smell is a communal resource, and someone is hoarding it.
cards.name: Assertive Odor
cards.power: Lingers in the commons, dominating the air supply of innocent bystanders.

cards.art: Toad covered in mushrooms festering next to toothbrush holder
cards.lore: Life finds a way, especially when you never wipe down the sink.
cards.name: Biohazard 95%
cards.power: Cultivates unclassified fungal infections right next to your toothbrush.

cards.art: Ring-tailed lemur with wide eyes staring into dark mess void
cards.lore: You gaze into the mess, and the mess touches you back.
cards.name: Existential Dread
cards.power: Strikes suddenly when you realize you share a wall with the abyss.

cards.art: Elephant recoiling from invisible smell, eyes closed in agony
cards.lore: You will remember the fossilized tomato on your deathbed.
cards.name: Olfactory Memory
cards.power: Permanently scars your brain with smells you can never un-smell.

cards.art: Starfish spawning identical trash piles across entire floor
cards.lore: It's reproducing. We cannot in good conscience guarantee structural integrity.
cards.name: Fractal Self-Organization
cards.power: Spawns smaller, identical piles of trash from the original mother-pile, forever.

cards.art: Walrus dissolving into layered fabric sediment swallowing room
cards.lore: The carpet is gone. There is only the fabric sediment now.
cards.name: Domestic Erosion
cards.power: Wears down the flat's architecture until only the laundry remains.

cards.art: Boar asleep beneath tower of takeout boxes reaching sky
cards.lore: Now with 400% more mold.
cards.name: Tower of Forgotten Feasts
cards.power: Stacks old takeout boxes until they achieve orbit.

cards.art: Moth pinned in ornate frame on cracked museum wall
cards.lore: It's not depression, it's a masterclass in living decay.
cards.name: Curated Domestic Decay
cards.power: Frames the rotting environment as an intentional lifestyle brand.

cards.art: Cuttlefish perfectly disguised in trash sculpture landscape
cards.lore: She's just curled up in there, plotting her next masterpiece.
cards.name: The Camouflaged Artist
cards.power: Hides effortlessly among her own trash sculptures and fossilized laundry.

cards.art: Frog completely embedded in sticky amber prize pool
cards.lore: You can take the prize home, if you can pry it free.
cards.name: The Sticky Context
cards.power: Binds the winning prize to its disgusting surroundings.

cards.art: Trilobite-shaped fossilized pizza slice embedded in geological strata
cards.lore: Cold. That's a geological pizza formation, not a person.
cards.name: The Pizza Fossil
cards.power: Tricks hunters into thinking they've found the artist.

cards.art: Tortoise biting red X cursor in explosion of frustration
cards.lore: Nope—that's just more laundry. Respect the camouflage.
cards.name: The Wrong Tap
cards.power: Drops a red ✗ and cycles through increasingly sarcastic UI hints.

cards.art: Poodle in beret with severe expression judging chaotic space
cards.lore: German efficiency, but make it exclusively about being disorganized.
cards.name: Süddeutsche Unordnung
cards.power: Declares the flat a Masterpiece of Not Now.

cards.art: Seagull exploding out of garbage bag with plates flying
cards.lore: (Admission is free, you live here.)
cards.name: The Daily Heap
cards.power: Confirms the plates alone are worth the price of admission.

cards.art: Peacock strutting in full denim and clothing plumage
cards.lore: Not since the invention of the laundry basket has an artist so boldly ignored one.
cards.name: Art & Mess Quarterly
cards.power: Marvels at a fearless dialogue between denim and despair.

cards.art: Vulture reading Xerox newspaper beside tiny bug critic
cards.lore: Anti-fashion's final form has finally arrived.
cards.name: The Sunday Rot
cards.power: Recommends keeping the exhibition strictly at arm's length.

cards.art: Woodpecker placing numbered forensic dot on red stain
cards.lore: It's not a stain, it's Case No. MMM-01.
cards.name: Evidence Marker No. 1
cards.power: Slaps a red numbered dot on ambiguous phenomena to make it forensic.

cards.art: Tarsier wearing enormous magnifying loupe, horrified by zoom truth
cards.lore: Click the image to zoom. Click outside to close your eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
cards.name: Magnifier Loupe
cards.power: Hovers over the main photo to reveal the horrifying high-res truth.

cards.art: Pangolin rolled into sealed ball containing mystery prize
cards.lore: Prize is non-refundable and possibly alive.
cards.name: Sealable Container
cards.power: Transports the interactive prize home without cross-contaminating your life.

cards.art: Frog wearing dripping yellow bio-gloves over contaminated yellow surface
cards.lore: Treat the mess as material, but treat the surfaces as lava.
cards.name: Bio-Gloves
cards.power: Provides the bare minimum barrier between your skin and the installation.

cards.art: Cheetah racing stopwatch beside dirty plate on countdown
cards.lore: Fossilization is a geological process, not a dishwashing strategy.
cards.name: The 24-Hour Dish
cards.power: Demands that dishes return to the kitchen before they petrify.

cards.art: Wombat sitting inside laundry basket with pure satisfaction
cards.lore: A laundry basket is a laundry basket. It's right there.
cards.name: The Actual Basket
cards.power: Proves that the floor is not, and has never been, a laundry basket.

cards.art: Three meerkats cooperatively cleaning bathroom mirror together
cards.lore: Tidy the room, you'll feel better. That's not an opinion, it's research.
cards.name: The Group Project
cards.power: Reminds everyone that the bathroom is a shared space and we are all being graded.

cards.art: Hummingbird zipping past stopwatch with cleaning tools trailing
cards.lore: That's the whole ask. It's not impossible.
cards.name: The 20-Minute Reset
cards.power: Requires one weekly session: music on, twenty minutes, done.

cards.art: Mantis shrimp bursting rainbow confetti across screen
cards.lore: A digital celebration for a basic analog compromise.
cards.name: The Rainbow Confetti
cards.power: Bursts across the screen the moment you accept the new terms of living.

cards.art: Slow loris holding 'World's Best Curator' mug with mild horror
cards.lore: Resist the urge to say I told you so.
cards.name: The Mild Horror
cards.power: Stays with the curator long after the bins are finally taken out.

cards.art: Seagull gliding through open window carrying fumes out
cards.lore: Just leave the windows open and let the flat heal.
cards.name: The Open Window
cards.power: Flushes the assertive odors and ambient fumes out into the wild.

cards.art: Orangutan at vintage computer ingesting papers into machine
cards.lore: Treat the mess as material, and the message as love.
cards.name: The Single Source
cards.power: Drops straight into NotebookLM to generate this exact slide deck.

cards.art: Green snake consuming PDF document whole, coiled with data
cards.lore: The canonical text source is absolute.
cards.name: The Notebook Ingestion
cards.power: Digests every verbatim quote, interaction spec, and visitor comment flawlessly.

cards.art: Iguana turning dial from yellow-black to solid green
cards.lore: When the page goes green, the lived reality begins.
cards.name: The Green Truth
cards.power: Shifts the page color to signal we have officially stopped joking.

cards.art: Flatfish breaking through cracked phone screen, grid collapsing
cards.lore: Auto-collapsing grids cannot contain the true mess.
cards.name: The 600px Limit
cards.power: Hides the decorative stickers when the screen gets too narrow.

cards.art: Baby chick in bowtie holding clipboard, inheriting living installation
cards.lore: Good luck. You're going to need a hazmat suit.
cards.name: The Next Curator
cards.power: Inherits the living installation, the clipboard, and the dread.
